evidence.quote: inflation is running close to, but a bit below, our 2 percent objective
Unemployment is near a half-century low
when inflation—and, consequently, interest rates—are too low, the Fed and other central banks have less room to cut rates to support the economy during downturns.
One clear takeaway of the sessions so far is the importance of sustaining our historically strong job market.
Doing so would help prevent inflation expectations among consumers, businesses, and investors from slipping too low
